note: Hand-written golden transcripts for the proxy's Anthropic codec. `host` is the conversation array (request.messages), not the whole request body: system is outside it, carries nothing to collapse, and is carried by the daemon. Each case must satisfy encode(decode(host)) === host byte for byte, with key order preserved, unknown fields (cache_control, is_error, metadata) surviving, and no tool call split from its result.

cases.name: plain-turns
cases.note: The baseline: text on both sides, and an empty content array to pin that an empty message survives rather than being dropped.

content.text: Summarise the plugin in one line.
It bounds the context window with an explicit state.

cases.name: tool-pair
cases.note: A call and its result in adjacent messages, with is_error and a content array on the result - the fields a rebuilt part would silently drop.

cases.name: thinking-and-signature
cases.note: A thinking block the core must not read but must preserve byte for byte, followed by text and a call. This is what strip/restore are for.

content.thinking: The user wants the pairing arithmetic checked, so I should read view.ts first.

cases.name: unknown-fields
cases.note: Fields the core vocabulary does not name: a server_tool_use part, a message metadata block, and a container on a text block. A codec that constructs rather than spreads drops all three.
